title: Juicy Tender Slovakian Pork Skillet
description: A peppery and tender solo dinner dish featuring cinnamon stick and lardons render, friendly for sugar free diets
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add the diced lardons to render the fat
Once the lardons are crispy, remove them from the skillet and set aside
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the pork cubes to the skillet and cook until they are browned on all sides
Add the broken cinnamon stick, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt to the skillet and stir to combine
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, until the pork is tender and the sauce has thickened
Stir in the crispy lardons and serve the pork skillet hot
